ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lobe interiors versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and perimeter edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central regions of both the left and right lobes. These are bordered by solid black pigmentation at the central notch and along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency black-to-white mottling (stipple-like transitions) is observed at the boundary interfaces between the black margins and white centers.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a sharp V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 65 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-frequency serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) are visible along the full extent of the trailing edge, with pixel amplitudes varying significantly between the inner notch and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to sharply tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white focal spots (2-5 pixel clusters) distributed across the black central peduncle area and along the lower black margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the medial section of the right white lobe, oriented vertically relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular protrusion with brownish-orange pixel discoloration is visible on the far left distal tip, indicating localized trauma or bio-accumulation. Various small circular scarring patterns are visible on the black ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: A yellowish-tan chromatic gradient is present within the interior white field of the left lobe, distinct from the primary white/black intensity levels.
